description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 is oncoming relative to Vehicle 1 and goes straight through the same intersection. Vehicle 3 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 1. Vehicle 4 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 3 in the same lane. On Vehicle 1’s exit road, a parked vehicle partially blocks the right edge of the lane, and farther down the exit road two cones are placed near the center of the lane.
